anchor: At TP1 no replica count is feasible: the burst's ≈36k-token frames-class prefills pin TTFT p99 at ≈1285 ms even at N=16, a prefill floor replica scaling cannot buy down.
claim_text: At TP1, no replica count is feasible because the burst's ~36k-token frames-class prefills pin TTFT p99 at ~1285 ms even at N=16, a prefill floor that replica scaling cannot reduce.

adjudication.evidence: At TP1, the TTFT p99 for burst3 and burst5 is exactly 1285.0754740000702 ms at both N=8 and N=16 (with feasible = false), demonstrating that replica scaling cannot buy down the prefill floor beneath the 1000 ms SLA target.
adjudication.fix: None required; the claim is fully supported and holds.
adjudication.query: SELECT window_name, tp, llm_workers, ttft_p99_ms, feasible FROM grid_llm_point WHERE tp = 1 AND window_name IN ('burst3', 'burst5') AND llm_workers IN (8, 16) ORDER BY window_name, llm_workers;

adjudication.observed: Across all six current, non-superseded burst windows, all five tested replica counts were infeasible. At N=16 TTFT p99 ranged from 1285.0754740000702 to 1299.3298530001193 ms; N=8-to-N=16 improvement ranged from 0 to 0.963377000298351 ms. The frames-class ctx_p50 is 33722 tokens.
adjudication.evidence: The DB supports infeasibility and an observed N=8-to-N=16 plateau only over tested points; it does not establish an absolute floor, causal pinning by frames prefills, or impossibility of improvement beyond N=16.
adjudication.fix: State: "At TP1, all five tested replica counts were infeasible; at N=16, burst-window TTFT p99 remained 1285.0754740000702–1299.3298530001193 ms, with at most 0.963377000298351 ms improvement from N=8." Remove the causal and absolute floor language.
adjudication.query: WITH tp1 AS ( SELECT d.window_name, d.n_replicas, d.encoder_workers, p.p99_ms, p.n_requests, g.feasible, d.is_current AS dim_current, p.is_current AS latency_current, d.superseded_by FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency p ON p.run_id=d.run_id AND p.experiment=d.experiment AND p.pool=d.pool JOIN provenance.grid_llm_point g ON g.report_run_id=d.run_id WHERE d.is_current=true AND p.is_current=true AND d.superseded_by IS NULL AND p.sla_metric='ttft' AND d.experiment='grid' AND g.tp=1 AND g.is_valid=true AND d.window_name LIKE 'burst%' AND d.n_replicas IN (1,2,4,8,16) AND d.run_id ~ '^grid:grid_llm_burst[1-6]_C[0-9]+_N(1|2|4|8|16)_aic$' ) SELECT window_name, COUNT(*) AS denominator_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT n_replicas) AS tested_replica_counts, MIN(n_replicas) AS min_n, MAX(n_replicas) AS max_n, BOOL_AND(NOT feasible) AS all_tested_points_infeasible, MIN(p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE n_replicas=16) AS n16_min_ttft_p99_ms, MAX(p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE n_replicas=16) AS n16_max_ttft_p99_ms, MIN(p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE n_replicas=8)-MAX(p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE n_replicas=16) AS n8_to_n16_min_change_ms, MIN(n_requests) AS requests_per_run, BOOL_AND(dim_current AND latency_current AND superseded_by IS NULL) AS all_current_nonsuperseded, (SELECT ctx_p50 FROM provenance.eda_request_class WHERE class_name='frames') AS frames_ctx_p50_tokens FROM tp1 GROUP BY window_name ORDER BY window_name
